settings.heading: Dispatch
settings.text: Add the working days normally needed to prepare an order before it leaves your store.

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.text: Add your delivery estimates, available regions and any shipping charges or thresholds.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.text: State your return window, acceptable item condition and any products that cannot be returned.

settings.heading: Refunds & exchanges
settings.text: Explain when refunds are issued, how exchanges are handled and whether any fees apply.

settings.heading: Contact the team
settings.text: Share your order number, the item involved and a short explanation of what you need.

settings.heading: Prepare the item
settings.text: Keep the product, included parts and original packaging together while your request is reviewed.

settings.heading: Follow the instructions
settings.text: Use the return guidance provided by the team and retain any shipping receipt until the process is complete.

settings.heading: When will my refund arrive?
settings.text: Add your inspection and refund processing timeline here. Banking providers may need additional time to post the credit.

settings.heading: Can I exchange an item?
settings.text: Explain whether direct exchanges are available or whether customers should return an item and place a new order.

settings.heading: What if my order arrives damaged?
settings.text: Ask customers to contact the team promptly with their order details and clear photos of the item and packaging.
